author: Contributor 85
about: The examples Upstash and Redis publish (spec/doc-examples.json, qstash/spec/doc-examples.json) on the operations the pack serves, each sent as its client sends it, with the setup its precondition needs: redis.io's command pages' statements and Upstash's REST API page's requests, through Upstash's REST API with the Standard token of a database the console made (Upstash-Encoding: base64, read through the decoded view), each page from an empty database; a statement of a command the twin does not serve is counted, not replayed, and the state it would make is made by a served command where one makes it; then QStash's and Workflow's pages' requests with the token of the QStash the console opened. A destination a page elides (https://my-api..., publish/...) is the World's https://<the name it shows>.example.com where the example's meaning survives it, and recorded where it does not (a batch whose messages are elided). exampleDiffers says why a World answers otherwise; notReplayed why an example cannot be replayed.
